items.headline: Hauss Hejny's 5 total touchdowns power Colorado State in 56-49 win over San Diego State
items.description: — Hauss Hejny accounted for five touchdowns — three passing and two rushing — and Colorado State snapped a four-game losing streak, holding off San Diego State 56-49 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Burgess, Jackson help Texas State rush for school-record 503 yards in 66-27 romp over Colorado State
items.description: — Torrance Burgess Jr. rushed for career highs of 224 yards and four touchdowns, Brad Jackson threw a touchdown pass and ran for career highs of 181 yards and three scores and Texas State steamrolled Colorado State 66-27 on Thursday night.
